pieces.list.statement: SELECT id, title, body, image_data, created_at FROM pieces ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

pieces.files.statement: SELECT id, file_id FROM pieces WHERE author_id = ?1 AND file_id <> '-' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

pieces.create.statement: INSERT INTO pieces(author_id, title, body, file_id, image_data, created_at) VALUES(?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6)
